title: 3Sum
description: Given an integer array nums, return all unique triplets [a, b, c] of distinct indices whose values sum to zero. The result must not contain duplicate triplets.

reference.use_case: Finding every unique set of three entries whose amounts net out exactly, such as three ledger entries that cancel each other during reconciliation.
system_examples: Accounting reconciliation tools — matching groups of debits and credits that net to zero across ledgers
Anti-money-laundering monitoring — flagging small groups of transfers between accounts whose amounts offset each other
Promotion engines — finding three-item bundles that hit an exact target price
reference.explanation: Brute force is O(n³). Sorting first lets you fix one element and sweep two pointers inward over the rest, giving O(n²) and making duplicate skipping trivial. Reducing k-sum to repeated 2-sum is the general approach for exact-total matching.
